Welcome to Snapmaker!
 
Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully before using this product. Your access to and use of this product is conditioned on your acceptance of and compliance with these terms. These terms apply to all users who access or use this product.
 
By using this product, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you disagree with any part of the terms then you may not use this product.
 
We reserve the right, at our sole discretion, to modify or replace these terms at any time.
 
Privacy Policy
 
Thanks for using our products and services. Snapmaker considers your privacy important and respects it. To this end, we have developed a Privacy Policy covering how we collect, use, disclose, transfer, and store your information.
 
We use your data to provide and improve our services. By using our services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
 
Personal Information Collection
 
When you use this device, we automatically collect certain device information including your IP address, device working time, and user preferences.
 
We collect device information using the following technology:
 
“Log files” track actions occurring on the device, and collect data including your use time, printer settings, printing models, and date/time stamps.
 
Snapmaker Touchscreen App uses the collected data for various purposes:
 1. To provide and maintain our services
 2. To notify you about changes to our services
 3. To allow you to participate in interactive features of our services when you choose to do so
 4. To provide customer care and support
 5. To provide analysis or valuable information so that we can improve our services
 6. To monitor the usage of our services
 7. To detect, prevent and address technical issues
 
Security
 
We use certain physical, organizational, and technical safeguards that are designed to improve the integrity and security of information that we collect and maintain. Please be aware that no security measures are perfect or impenetrable and thus we cannot and do not guarantee that your information will not be accessed, viewed, disclosed, altered, or destroyed by breach of any of our physical, technical, or organizational safeguards.
 
Changes to This Privacy Policy
 
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.
 
Contact Us
 
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us by email at support@snapmaker.com.
 
Disclaimer
 
Please read and understand the user manual before using this product. Failure to follow operating instructions may result in personal injuries, inferior results or damage to the product. Always make sure that anyone who uses this product knows and understands the user manual and follows the operating instructions.
 
As the conditions or methods of assembling, handling, storage, use or disposal of this product are beyond our control. For this reason, we do not assume responsibility and expressly disclaim liability for loss, injuries, damage, or expense arising out of or in connection with the assembling, handling, storage, use or disposal of this product.

Privacy Policy 

Thank you for choosing the products and services of Shenzhen Snapmaker Technologies Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as “we” or “us”). 
Your privacy is critically important to us. Our privacy policy is designed to enhance transparency and help you understand our privacy safeguards in a format that is easy to read and browse. Please read the following sections to learn how we obtain, process, share, and protect your information in order to provide you with a seamless product experience. You do not have to agree to this Privacy Policy, but if you choose not to agree to this Privacy Policy, we will not be able to provide you with our products or services in full. 

Information We May Collect 

1. Basic Device Information 
 • How we collect information 
 Basic device information (i.e., machine name, model name, and firmware version information; connection status: hardware communication connection status, and status of telecommunication with Snapmaker Luban; screen operation information; and firmware logs and error messages) is stored locally in log files on your device, which we cannot access unless you provide them to us voluntarily. In some cases, you may need to send such log files to us by email or otherwise for us to provide relevant support. 
 • Types and purposes of information 
 To ensure the normal operation of the machine and an excellent service experience, we may obtain the following information from the log files you provide: 
 1. Machine name, model name, and firmware version information, for purposes such as establishing telecommunication and updating firmware. 
 2. Connection status: hardware communication connection status and status of telecommunication with Snapmaker Luban, for the purpose of checking the connection status of the machine and promptly reporting exceptions (if any). 
 3. Screen operation information, for the purpose of recording your current location on the page and status, so as to help you quickly restore normal operation when exceptions occur. 
 4. Firmware logs and error messages, for the purpose of locating the problem when you do not have the relevant failure detection conditions. 

2. Personalized Device Information 
For the information we obtain after you have chosen and expressly agreed to participate in the User Experience Improvement Program, please refer to the User Experience Improvement Program. 

How We Process Information Obtained 

• Use 
 Subject to applicable laws and administrative regulations, we may use the information we obtain for: 
 • analyzing the operation status of the machine. 
 • performing the contract signed with you (our terms of use or other contracts) to ensure the normal use of products and provide complete after-sales services. 
 • providing support for our services, including product or service improvement, fault analysis, and problem diagnosis. 

• Retention 
 We retain your information to provide you and other users with better services. Our goal is to retain the information you provide only for the time necessary to achieve the purposes specified and within the retention period specified by laws and administrative regulations. When determining the retention period, we will carefully evaluate the necessity of data collection, the type of data collected, the relevant legal framework, and the limitation of action. 

How You Manage Information You Provide 

We respect and protect your rights in the information you have provided, and you have the right to access, correct, update, or delete the information you have provided, and the right to object, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to the processing of such information. When we process information with your consent, you may also change the scope of your authorization or consent or withdraw your consent. If you change the scope of authorization or consent or withdraw your consent, it will not affect the legitimacy of our processing of authorized information up until the time of such change or withdrawal. 

However, please note that if you exercise the right to delete or the right to object to the processing of your information, or change the scope of your authorization or consent or withdraw your consent, we may not be able to provide you with all or part of the features and functions of our products or services. 

If you wish to exercise any of the rights as mentioned in this section or provided by applicable law, you may contact us at support@snapmaker.com. 

How We Share and Protect Information Obtained 

• Sharing 
 We will not voluntarily share your information with other companies, organizations or individuals unless we obtain your express consent. We may share your information with a third party as required by laws and regulations, as needed for litigation dispute resolution, or as requested by administrative or judicial authorities in accordance with the law. We do not share your information with third parties for their marketing purposes. 

• Protection 
 We use administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information. However, due to technical limitations and possible malicious means, please understand that we cannot guarantee that there is no security risk despite all these efforts. We will continue to improve these security measures and do our best to keep your personal information secure at all times. 

Privacy of Minors 

We treat anyone under the age of 18, or any other age prescribed by local laws, as a minor. Minors shall use our products under the escort and supervision of adults. The information we may obtain is only related to the machine, so we will not obtain the personal information of minors. 

Changes to this Privacy Policy 

We reserve the right to modify or update this Privacy Policy, and will inform you of any changes to this Privacy Policy through this interface. 

Contact Us 

If you have any questions, comments or suggestions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@snapmaker.com
